claim: Fudan and Peking Universities researchers published a paper on Agentic Harness Engineering
source_quote: A team at Fudan and Peking Universities (Lin, Liu, Pan et al., April 2026, paper v4 on arXiv 2604.25850) introduced a method called Agentic Harness Engineering, or AHE

claim: The paper achieved 77.0% pass@1 accuracy on Terminal-Bench 2 after ten automated iterations
source_quote: After ten automated iterations, the method lifted pass@1 accuracy on Terminal-Bench 2 from 69.7% to 77.0%

claim: Code is available on GitHub at china-qijizhifeng/agentic-harness-engineering
source_quote: The code is open on GitHub at china-qijizhifeng/agentic-harness-engineering

claim: Authors include Lin, Liu, Pan et al.
Performance regressed by about 2.3 percentage points when only the system prompt was evolved
source_quote: performance did not improve; it actually regressed by about 2.3 percentage points

claim: Frozen harness added between 5 and 10 percentage points on SWE-bench-verified and three alternate model families
source_quote: adding between roughly 5 and 10 percentage points

claim: AHE defines three pillars of observability: component, experience, and decision observability
source_quote: First, component observability: ... Second, experience observability: ... Third, decision observability:

claim: In well-built agents, the prompt is not where the leverage is
source_quote: in a well-built agent, the prompt is not where the leverage is

claim: The harness — tools, middleware, and memory — is where the performance actually lives
source_quote: the harness — tools, middleware, and memory — is where the performance actually lives

claim: Gains came almost entirely from tools, middleware, and long-term memory, not from the prompt
source_quote: The gains came almost entirely from the tools, the middleware, and the long-term memory

claim: AHE improves scaffolding around the model rather than memorizing a test
source_quote: it means AHE is improving the scaffolding around the model, not memorizing a test

claim: The benefit of the evolved harness survives a change of both task and base model
source_quote: the benefit survives a change of both task and base model
